title: Previous CURRENT backbox
note: Historical V33.8 reference. Monitor rails, shoes, adjustable stop rail and multi-piece lower cassette are audited for retirement.

title: Simplified shell
note: 780 mm width / 723.9 mm shell height / accepted side depth and WPC interface preserved. One-face inside guides and front rebates only.

title: Two stops on bare side panels
note: Two identical 12 x 40 x 30 mm offcuts screwed directly to inside side faces. Stop top Z854; no adjusters.

title: Floor and sides squared
note: Dry fit floor capture; square before final fixation. Permanent monitor plate has not yet been inserted.

title: Monitor plate enters from ABOVE
note: Assembly-only insertion. 4 mm side captures; guide width = measured plate thickness + coupon clearance. Top absent.

title: Plate seated on both stops
note: Plate is one flat 18 mm part. 12 mm was screened first and exceeded the stated planning deflection criterion.

title: Top closes the guide exits
note: The top is permanently assembled after seating the plate. No extra plate-retention brackets. Plate is not routinely removed.

title: Top joint: direct mechanical fastening
note: Existing shallow captured interface + glue + four direct side screws. Four pocket screws studied as an alternative; exact Kreg geometry unknown, so none is fabricated or assumed.

title: Monitor approaches from FRONT
note: Top and plate stay installed. Insert monitor at +5 mm entry height through 744 mm clear throat (740 mm reference width). Rear access installs VESA bolts.

title: Rear VESA tool approach
note: R10 x160 mm socket/driver corridors checked with rear doors open. All thread, washer, boss depth and screw engagement data await purchased monitor.

title: Vertical VESA adjustment
note: 75/100 mm patterns; 5 mm reference slot width +10 mm centre travel =15 mm overall slot. +/-5 mm monitor height. Exact width remains HOLD.

title: Hardware-only depth stacks: 0 /3 /6 /9 /12 mm
note: No wooden depth shoes. Reference increments only. Screw length = plate + washer + spacer + selected engagement; must not bottom in VESA boss.

title: Monitor installed
note: Monitor weight transfers via VESA plate to guides/stops and side shell. Fold normal-load screen is provisional; plywood properties and full load qualification remain required.

title: One DMD / speaker panel
note: One 18 mm panel; 12 mm failed the conservative folded-load deflection screen. Central region remains wood to receive rear-access VESA bolts. Display sits in FRONT, not behind a fascia cutout.

title: DMD fitted directly to panel
note: VESA75 example, 400 x200 x45 mm body reserve. No rear plywood adapter. Actual monitor and VESA location must be selected before final machining.

title: Speakers fitted to SAME panel
note: Direct speaker mounting; reference diameter130 and <=60 mm rear depth. Old103 mm depth conflicts with protected intakes. Hardware-dependent, no universal speaker fit claim.

title: Completed lower panel enters from FRONT
note: Four side-operated positive bolts into cross-dowels; no plywood cleat stacks. Side access and actual hardware qualification required.

title: Lower panel fixed
note: Side rebates locate front/rear. Four bolts prevent release in fold. Removable panel is independent of captured monitor plate.

title: Front glass rebates and padded lower seat
note: Inside FACE_A side cuts leave12 mm outside skin. Bottom seat is one18 mm part with 8 mm top groove;6 mm front capture lip; replaceable cushions prevent hard contact.

title: Glass enters from FRONT
note: Lower edge into padded seat, then tilt glass rearward. Top remains fixed. Shown10-degree CAD path; keep upper strip off.

title: Glass seated
note: Nominal study glass752 x459 x4 mm; final size from opening, actual liner and fit. Earlier465 mm height is not the final cut authority.

title: One removable upper strip
note: 12 mm stock strip, two upward screws from front/below. 8.2 mm overlap,3.8 mm top travel. Remove strip without removing shell top.

title: Laid-back glass retention
note: Bottom U lip, lateral/back side seats and upper strip provide geometric capture. No gravity-only or friction-only retention. Impact, liner compression and purchased fasteners remain physical holds.

title: Rear service, both doors open100 degrees
note: Rear lock approach, VESA access, existing fans/intakes and door architecture preserved. New smaller speaker-depth envelope is explicit.

title: Populated90-degree fold
note: Main playfield glass/matrix removed; rear locks parked; doors closed/latched. New geometry has required-angle samples plus continuous differential collision certificate.

title: Complete simplified exploded backbox
note: Semantic exploded positions only: sides /2 stops /1 plate /top /monitor; one lower panel /DMD /2 speakers; glass /one strip. No rail, shoe, M067 or cassette frame.
